fnol_text: My name is Leila Sorensen and I live at 118 Thornbury Court, Ashland, OR 97516. You can reach me on (555) 226-6130 or leila.sorensen@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 30 January 2026. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2024-00117. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Sorensen on (555) 226-6130 to acknowledge the claim. Leila confirmed the loss date as 30 January 2026.
Site visit to 118 Thornbury Court. Neighbour Mateo Whitfield was present and confirmed the timeline.
Leila sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
